trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: This is the platinum trophy awarded for earning all other 54 trophies in the game. Focus on completing the story first, then clean up collectibles and activities. No specific action required beyond earning everything else. Source: https://psnprofiles.com/trophies/43531-grand-theft-auto-vi

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Complete the opening mission 'Gone Fishing' which serves as the game's tutorial. This mission introduces the dual-protagonist mechanic and basic controls. It unlocks automatically as you start the game. Source: https://psnprofiles.com/trophies/43531-grand-theft-auto-vi

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Finish all missions in Chapter 1 of the main story. This chapter establishes the setting in Leonida and introduces key characters. Simply progress through the narrative missions marked on your map. Source: https://psnprofiles.com/trophies/43531-grand-theft-auto-vi

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Complete all missions in Chapter 2. The story expands into Vice City proper with new criminal enterprises. Follow the main mission markers to advance the chapter. Source: https://psnprofiles.com/trophies/43531-grand-theft-auto-vi

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 3's storyline missions. This chapter deepens the conflict with rival gangs and cartels. Continue following the primary mission path to complete it. Source: https://psnprofiles.com/trophies/43531-grand-theft-auto-vi

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 4, the final chapter of the main story. This concludes the primary narrative arc before the finale. All story missions in this chapter must be finished. Source: https://psnprofiles.com/trophies/43531-grand-theft-auto-vi

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Complete the final story mission of the game. This gold trophy marks the end of the main campaign. Simply play through to the conclusion of the narrative. Source: https://psnprofiles.com/trophies/43531-grand-theft-auto-vi

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Complete the 'Breakfast Run' mission, an early story mission introducing key mechanics. This is a mandatory story mission that cannot be missed. Progress naturally through the campaign. Source: https://psnprofiles.com/trophies/43531-grand-theft-auto-vi

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Finish 'The Cartel Heist' mission, a major story heist sequence. This mission features a significant set piece with multiple phases. It unlocks as part of the main story progression. Source: https://psnprofiles.com/trophies/43531-grand-theft-auto-vi

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Complete the 'Child's Play' story mission. This mission develops the relationship between the protagonists. Follow the main mission marker to trigger and complete it. Source: https://psnprofiles.com/trophies/43531-grand-theft-auto-vi

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Finish the 'Headliners' story mission. This mission involves a high-profile target and media spectacle. It is a required main story mission. Source: https://psnprofiles.com/trophies/43531-grand-theft-auto-vi

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Complete the 'VCIA Takedown' mission, infiltrating a government facility. This is a major story set piece with stealth and action sections. Progress through the campaign to reach it. Source: https://psnprofiles.com/trophies/43531-grand-theft-auto-vi

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Finish 'Operation Savage Glory', a late-game story mission. This mission features intense combat in a unique location. It is part of the mandatory story path. Source: https://psnprofiles.com/trophies/43531-grand-theft-auto-vi

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Achieve 100% completion in the game. This requires finishing all story missions, stranger missions, collectibles, activities, and challenges. This is the most time-consuming trophy and typically earned last. Source: https://www.powerpyx.com/gta-6-grand-theft-auto-vi-trophy-guide-roadmap/

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Complete 250 unique stunts across the map. Stunts are marked by ramp icons and require landing jumps cleanly. Focus on stunt locations near highways and construction sites for efficient grinding. Source: https://psnprofiles.com/trophies/43531-grand-theft-auto-vi

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Participate in each of the 9 activity types at least once. Activities include racing, shooting ranges, drone races, fishing, arcade games, and more. Simply try one of each type as you encounter them. Source: https://psnprofiles.com/trophies/43531-grand-theft-auto-vi

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal on all 42 Shooting Range challenges. Practice each challenge to learn the target patterns and timing. Gold requires high accuracy and speed; replay challenges to improve. Source: https://psnprofiles.com/trophies/43531-grand-theft-auto-vi

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at all 14 locations across Leonida. Drone races test precision flying through checkpoints. Upgrade your drone handling and memorize each course layout. Source: https://psnprofiles.com/trophies/43531-grand-theft-auto-vi

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different standard races (not drone races). Race events appear on the map after unlocking them. Focus on circuit races first as they're more forgiving than point-to-point. Source: https://psnprofiles.com/trophies/43531-grand-theft-auto-vi

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Defeat Cal in a fishing challenge. Cal is a fishing rival found at specific pier locations. Use the right bait for the target fish and master the reeling mechanic. Source: https://psnprofiles.com/trophies/43531-grand-theft-auto-vi

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Complete any one arcade game in the game world. Arcades are found in malls and entertainment venues. Simply play and finish a single game session. Source: https://psnprofiles.com/trophies/43531-grand-theft-auto-vi

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission in Andy's stranger mission strand. Andy's missions appear as 'A' icons on the map after meeting him. Finish all his missions to unlock the finale. Source: https://psnprofiles.com/trophies/43531-grand-theft-auto-vi

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Finish Kenton's final stranger mission. Kenton's strand involves maritime activities and investigations. Complete his full mission line to earn this. Source: https://psnprofiles.com/trophies/43531-grand-theft-auto-vi

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete Billy's last stranger mission. Billy's missions focus on biker gang activities. Progress through his entire strand to reach the conclusion. Source: https://psnprofiles.com/trophies/43531-grand-theft-auto-vi

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 full stranger mission strands across Leonida. Each stranger has a multi-mission storyline marked by unique icons. There are more than 8 available, so you can choose which to finish. Source: https://psnprofiles.com/trophies/43531-grand-theft-auto-vi

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Finish Randy's final stranger mission. Randy's missions involve supply runs and resource management. Complete his entire storyline. Source: https://psnprofiles.com/trophies/43531-grand-theft-auto-vi

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete Tyrone's last stranger mission. Tyrone's strand centers on car culture and racing. See his missions through to the end. Source: https://psnprofiles.com/trophies/43531-grand-theft-auto-vi

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 meditation spots scattered across Leonida. This is the ONLY missable trophy in the game - some spots become inaccessible after certain story points. Visit all spots as early as possible, ideally before finishing Chapter 2. Source: https://psnprofiles.com/trophies/43531-grand-theft-auto-vi

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt the unique legendary animal for Bret. This requires tracking a specific rare animal in the wilderness. Use appropriate weapons and bait; the animal appears in a fixed region. Source: https://psnprofiles.com/trophies/43531-grand-theft-auto-vi

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 full Collectible Card sets. Cards are found as collectibles throughout the world. Each set requires multiple cards; check your collection menu for progress. Source: https://psnprofiles.com/trophies/43531-grand-theft-auto-vi

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Use the WAiNK social media app at 100 different locations. The app prompts you to check in at landmarks and points of interest. Simply use it whenever you see the prompt while exploring. Source: https://psnprofiles.com/trophies/43531-grand-theft-auto-vi

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 Challenges. Challenges are diverse objectives like weapon kills, driving feats, and activity scores. They track automatically; focus on variety to reach 50 naturally. Source: https://psnprofiles.com/trophies/43531-grand-theft-auto-vi

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star wanted level while accompanied by your partner character. Commit crimes together, then evade police using co-op mechanics. The partner must survive the escape. Source: https://psnprofiles.com/trophies/43531-grand-theft-auto-vi

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 consecutive shops with your partner without losing your wanted level. Plan a route hitting 3 stores quickly; use suppressors and coordinate with your partner. Escape cleanly after the third. Source: https://psnprofiles.com/trophies/43531-grand-theft-auto-vi

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover and drive 100 unique vehicles. Vehicle discovery counts when you enter a new vehicle type. Steal parked cars, buy from dealerships, and complete vehicle missions. Source: https://psnprofiles.com/trophies/43531-grand-theft-auto-vi

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Kill 5 enemies in a single activation of Combat Focus (slow-mo ability). Build up the Combat Focus meter, then trigger it during a large firefight. Aim for headshots to maximize efficiency. Source: https://psnprofiles.com/trophies/43531-grand-theft-auto-vi

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure from the VCIA facility. This occurs during a specific story mission where you must escape the building. Follow the mission objectives to trigger it. Source: https://psnprofiles.com/trophies/43531-grand-theft-auto-vi

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Deal with Rhino tanks during a mission or free-roam encounter. Rhinos appear in military zones and certain heists. Use explosives, heavy weapons, or vehicle combat to destroy them. Source: https://psnprofiles.com/trophies/43531-grand-theft-auto-vi

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. This requires stealth approach: disable alarms, avoid cameras, and use silent takedowns. The jewelry store heist has a specific stealth path. Source: https://psnprofiles.com/trophies/43531-grand-theft-auto-vi

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and successfully escape each time. Bank heists are multi-step missions requiring preparation. Complete 5 distinct bank robbery missions and evade police afterward. Source: https://psnprofiles.com/trophies/43531-grand-theft-auto-vi

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape with the loot. Armored trucks patrol fixed routes; intercept one and breach the back. Lose the ensuing wanted level to complete. Source: https://psnprofiles.com/trophies/43531-grand-theft-auto-vi

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all 52 named regions of Leonida. The map reveals regions as you enter them. Drive, fly, and boat to every corner of the map; fast travel helps but doesn't count for undiscovered areas. Source: https://psnprofiles.com/trophies/43531-grand-theft-auto-vi

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob one illegal operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs. Gang operations appear as icons on the map after intel gathering. Identify each gang's territory and hit one operation per gang. Source: https://psnprofiles.com/trophies/43531-grand-theft-auto-vi

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. Visit the specific bar location on Ocean Beach during evening hours. Interact with the drink prompt at the designated viewpoint. Source: https://psnprofiles.com/trophies/43531-grand-theft-auto-vi

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash out of a vehicle showroom in a dramatic exit. Drive a vehicle through the showroom windows during a mission or free roam. The showroom is in a major city district. Source: https://psnprofiles.com/trophies/43531-grand-theft-auto-vi

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Play bowling at the Kolt & Associates alley.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: Experience a partnership moment with mass appeal. This occurs during a specific story beat with your partner character. Progress the story to trigger this narrative moment. Source: https://psnprofiles.com/trophies/43531-grand-theft-auto-vi

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Make choices tracked by the PSN system (500 total across playthroughs). Dialogue choices and mission approaches count. This accumulates naturally over multiple playthroughs or a thorough single run. Source: https://psnprofiles.com/trophies/43531-grand-theft-auto-vi

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Succeed on a second attempt after failing a mission or objective. Simply retry and complete any failed mission. This happens naturally during normal play. Source: https://psnprofiles.com/trophies/43531-grand-theft-auto-vi

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: Witness a strange/unexplained event in the world. These are rare random encounters or specific locations with odd phenomena. Explore remote areas at night for best chances. Source: https://psnprofiles.com/trophies/43531-grand-theft-auto-vi

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Knock down a pedestrian with a melee drive-by attack. Lean out the window of a moving vehicle and melee strike a pedestrian. Requires timing and vehicle control. Source: https://psnprofiles.com/trophies/43531-grand-theft-auto-vi

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder $250,000 in Marked Bills through your criminal contacts. Marked Bills are earned from heists and robberies. Visit laundering contacts regularly to process the money. Source: https://psnprofiles.com/trophies/43531-grand-theft-auto-vi

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 total across all shops and services. Buy weapons, vehicles, clothes, properties, and upgrades. This accumulates naturally while playing. Source: https://psnprofiles.com/trophies/43531-grand-theft-auto-vi

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Purchase all 8 garage properties available for sale. Garages unlock as you progress and earn money. Check the property menu and buy each one as it becomes available. Source: https://psnprofiles.com/trophies/43531-grand-theft-auto-vi

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles in the Scooter Bros app. The app unlocks mid-game; use it to register vehicles you own or steal. Each unique vehicle counts once. Source: https://psnprofiles.com/trophies/43531-grand-theft-auto-vi
